item.title: Contemporary House
item.description: Bring your urban game worlds to life with this charming Pixel-Low Poly Modular Contemporary House pack — designed for creators who want simplicity, style, and flexibility in their environments.This asset provides a collection of modular building pieces that let you quickly construct contemporary-style houses, interiors, and small urban scenes with a clean low-poly aesthetic.
